script.cover_1: One short question from a manager, and the junior goes quiet.
script.payoff: It can sound like blame, so the junior hides the blocker.
script.caption: A question about the work can land as a verdict. Send this to the boss who asks why it is pending.
script.lands: It may sound like blame, so the junior hides the blocker and says almost done.
script.better: What is blocking this, and what can I clear for you?
script.why: It asks for the blocker and offers help, so the real problem comes out.
